title: platform-objects sys_organization: rename_organization, update_organization, delete_organization and change_slug carry no membership-reach gate, so a plain member is offered organisation-admin buttons the doors refuse
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2910 dev report (cloud PR #3034, report `6253450898`), out-of-scope finding 1. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What was read (framework pin `ec749fbb44b5`)

In `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts`, only `invite_user` (`:155`) carries `requiresMembershipReach` (`'invite_member'`, `:173`, ADR-0108 D1). The organisation-admin actions beside it carry `requiresFeature` only:

| action | line | locations | door | who the door admits |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `rename_organization` | `:234` | `record_header`, `list_item` | `/api/v1/auth/organization/update` | better-auth `organization: ['update']`: owner and admin |
| `update_organization` | `:88` | `list_item` | `/api/v1/auth/organization/update` | the same |
| `delete_organization` | `:111` | `list_item` | `/api/v1/auth/organization/delete` | better-auth `organization: ['delete']`: owner |
| `change_slug` | `:260` | `record_header` | cloud's `/api/v1/cloud/organizations/{id}/change-slug` | cloud `org-admin` (`cloud-route-authz.ts:243`, `callerCanRenameOrg`) |

The reach table (`packages/spec/src/identity/membership-reach.ts`) has rows for the invitation, member and team endpoints (`:99-145`). It has none for `organization: ['update']` or `organization: ['delete']`, so these actions have no reach to declare.

## What a user sees

- A plain member opens their organisation's record page (cloud's `cloud_organization_detail`, or the framework's default page).
- With the invitation hidden by its gate, the header draws 「重命名组织」 (the filled button) and 「修改标识符」 inline, as the console at objectui `43efd078` lays them out (`containers.tsx` `:1882` order sort, `:2062` primary pick).
- A click is refused by the door.
- The list rows offer 编辑 / 删除 the same way.

**Not measured:** the public doors' refusal answers for a plain member. The rows above are read from better-auth's default statements, which the reach table itself is read from (its docblock, `:33`), and from cloud's route ledger.

## Wanted

Each organisation-admin action declares the grades that reach its door, as `invite_user` does, so the console hides it from a grade the door refuses:
- reach rows for `organization: ['update']` (owner, admin) and `organization: ['delete']` (owner);
- `requiresMembershipReach` on `rename_organization`, `update_organization` and `delete_organization`;
- for `change_slug`, the same reach as the rename (its cloud door is `org-admin`), or the lane's own shape for a door outside better-auth.

`leave_organization` needs no gate: every grade may leave.

## Dedupe

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#21795 (closed): "a plain member is offered Invite User (and other org-admin affordances) that the server then refuses with 403". It introduced `requiresMembershipReach` and gated the invitation. This card is the rest of that family, on `sys_organization`.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#24318 (open): `change_slug` targets a cloud-only route, so an open-source composition answers 404. That is a different defect on the same action.
- Searched for: `rename_organization membership reach`, `plain member org admin buttons refused`.
